notes: Library view on /books: a cover grid on a computer and rows on a phone, a segmented status filter with counts, 'Search books' at the top, a sort menu, book-shaped loading placeholders and an empty shelf with Add book. The test-writer's spec sorts by title, so the old order question is settled. Baselines that end on /books were regenerated. On a phone the status filter is a 2x2 grid of 44 px segments with no sideways scroll; on a computer the filter track, Sort, search input and button are all 36 px tall. Phone overflow fix: title has [overflow-wrap:anywhere] (break-words removed from the title because Tailwind's break-words overrides it), author is truncate, and the row li has min-w-0 so the single-column grid track cannot grow past the viewport. The verifier FAILED the version without min-w-0 (a long spaced author gave scrollWidth 722 at 390 px). With min-w-0 the verifier PASSED (2026-11-17): scrollWidth 390 = innerWidth with a long unbroken title and a long spaced author, and no overflow at 320/375/414/768/1024. Follow-ups accepted by the owner (2026-11-18), not fixed in this feature: (1) the /books filter row wraps at 1024 px; (2) StatusTabs segments are 28 px tall from 640 to 1023 px; (3) the grid placeholder cover repeats and cuts the title; (4) docs/design/M9.md still describes a scrolling filter. 2026-11-18 review fixes: SearchForm takes a tall prop that only /books passes, so /quotes keeps its 32 px search (F048-quotes.png restored from main); the Tag picker on /books has an sr-only label and an h-9 trigger, so the status filter, Tag and Sort share one center line (F064-list-tags.png regenerated). The Shelf picker still has a visible label above it and a 32 px trigger, the same misalignment when shelves exist (follow-up). Verifier PASS at 393083e. | 2026-11-19: the placeholder cover is one centered serif initial drawn by a cover-initial CSS utility (::before reading data-initial), so a row's innerText starts with the title and F034's shelf-filter spec keeps reading titles; ShelfSelect has an sr-only label and an h-9 trigger; F090 and F034 baselines regenerated. Verifier PASS at the fix commit. Designer note for follow-up: at 390 px the Shelf trigger is text-width while Sort below it is full width. | 2026-11-20: CI on PR #230 cannot go green with PNGs only (owner's chosen fix). Reproduced locally on c4564c1 (main already merged): (1) status-filter, F086-live-list (3 tests), F088-light-dark 'pages follow the system' expect the 'Book filter' nav on an empty shelf, which F090's empty state removes per M9; (2) F082-cover-display looks for the placeholder letter with getByText('Z'), but the CSS ::before initial is not text, and it expects a 40x60 thumbnail where the 1280 px grid draws 173 px; (3) F064-list-tags differs on every run because a long stamped title overflows its grid cell and shows outside the screenshot mask. Each needs either a code change or a 'Specs that move' amendment with architect PASS.
